_README: Hand-picked photographs, keyed by scientific name, valued by iNaturalist observation id. Photos are otherwise chosen by community votes, which reward a striking picture rather than a legible one — six of the eight best-voted Eastern Blue Groper shots are head-on portraits, and five of eight Red Morwong, beautiful and useless for telling one fish from another. Prefer a side-on view of the whole animal. Paste the observation id from the 'see the observation' link. Delete an entry to hand the choice back to the ranking.
